svg.text: Main-only demo: Pod A and Pod B concurrency
1,200 randomized success records; Pod A=16 permits; Pod B=8 permits
Main worker A (16 permits) - 590 successful handlers, peakActive=13
Main worker B (8 permits) - 610 successful handlers, peakActive=8
Source: one Docker log file per main-worker replica; activeAtStart is a pod-local handler-entry snapshot.
